ValidationRule.description: Checks to see if the complaints case is ready to close
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Complaint", ISCHANGED(Status), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed"), NOT(ISPICKVAL(SC_ReadytoClose__c, "Complaint - Ready")), NOT($Permission.SC_BypassValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The case cannot be closed until the Complaint Outcome has been populated on the public complaint record
